name: Pokémon Sword & Shield
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. Version-exclusive gym slots: Bea (Sword) and Allister (Shield) share order 40 at Stow-on-Side; Gordie (Sword) and Melony (Shield) share order 60 at Circhester. Galarian forms are recorded via the form field (Yamask, Weezing, Rapidash, Darmanitan). Champion Cup order follows the story: Hop is the semifinal (order 90), Bede interrupts the finals (order 100), Leon is the championship match (order 110). Hop's semifinal team also includes a Lv 49 fully evolved starter (Rillaboom / Cinderace / Inteleon, whichever is weak to the player's starter) which is NOT listed, so his listed levelCap (48) is one below the true cap of 49. Leon's team has two variable Lv 64 slots set by the player's starter (Grookey -> Seismitoad + Cinderace; Scorbunny -> Mr. Rime + Inteleon; Sobble -> Rhyperior + Rillaboom); only his four fixed members are listed, and his cap is set by Gigantamax Charizard (65).
